project: Agent Monitor - Ark Console visual style

chart-access.expression: (() => { const charts = [...document.querySelectorAll('.overview-main canvas')]; const bad = charts.filter(c => {const d = document.getElementById(c.id.replace('-chart','-data')); return !d || !d.querySelector('summary') || !d.querySelector('tbody tr');}); return {pass: charts.length === 3 && bad.length === 0, samples:charts.length,detail:'charts='+charts.length+' missing equivalent tables='+bad.length};})()

quota-filter-adjacency.expression: (() => {const b=document.querySelector('#codex-account-actions'), f=document.querySelector('#quota-explorer'), t=document.querySelector('.quota-table-wrap'); return {pass:!!(b&&f&&t&&(b.compareDocumentPosition(f)&4)&&(f.compareDocumentPosition(t)&4)),samples:b&&f&&t?1:0,detail:'Batch workspace precedes quota-only filters and results'};})()

history-context.expression: (() => {const w=document.querySelector('.quota-table-wrap'), b=document.querySelector('#quota-past-accounts'); if(!w||!b||b.hidden)return {pass:false,samples:0,detail:'Expanded historical account sample required'};const clip=w.getBoundingClientRect();const nodes=[document.querySelector('.quota-past-toggle'),...b.querySelectorAll('.quota-account-observation')];const visible=el=>{if(!el)return false;const r=document.createRange();r.selectNodeContents(el);const x=r.getBoundingClientRect();return x.width>0&&x.left>=clip.left-1&&x.right<=clip.right+1;};return {pass:nodes.length>1&&nodes.every(visible),samples:nodes.length,detail:'Visible history title and row provenance; scrollLeft='+w.scrollLeft};})()
